Station construction matches listing 0.jpg: a heart-cut clear CZ held in 3 prongs, a single-row pave halo of ~22 round stones, and a deep polished yellow-gold heart cup with soldered side loops. Stations are joined by 2-3 short cable links (ring, oval, ring). The listing's halo is a finer, denser pave band; the plate's halo stones are larger and fewer. It still reads as the same piece.
The connector cable links are drawn slightly chunky: the oval link is ~0.35-0.4x the heart width, vs ~0.25-0.3x in listing 0.jpg.
Halo stones on the shadow side render smoky taupe (~RGB 140,110,95) and the lit side near-white (~237,223,218). They read as clear pave at phone size, and the centre stones are colourless.

Scale: there is no referent in frame. By FFT, the fabric weave pitch is 15-20 px against hearts ~410-420 px wide, i.e. ~21-28 threads per heart. That is consistent with a ~5mm heart on a fine weave, and nothing reads oversized.
Ground is L83 C23 h56, on the peach target (#EEBBA0, ~h55). No text, logos or extra jewellery; contact shadows are present.

reasons: SCALE: the hearts are ~1.7-1.8x the ~5mm spec. They measure 105-116 px across (heart at x707-820 = 112 px; heart at x900-1016 = 116 px), while the apricot halves (the 45mm referent) measure ~568-575 px across (left half x354-~930, y1453-2028; right half x1114-1681, y1107-1679). At ~12.7 px/mm each heart reads ~8.5-9mm, about 1/5 of a half's width instead of ~1/9. Cross-check: the paperclip links are ~123-128 px long, ~1.1x the heart width, vs ~1.5-1.9x in listing photos 1-3. So the hearts are inflated relative to their own chain as well.

IMPOSSIBLE DRAPE: stations 2-3 sit on the left half's cut face and 7-8 on the right half's face, while 4-5 lie on the silk between the halves and 1 and 6 perch on the rims. The halves are ~20mm tall (their shadows run ~345 px), but the connector between stations is only ~80-90 px in plan (~0.75 of a heart). There is no chain to drop off each half and climb back up, so the run behaves as if the halves were flat discs.

MALFORMED STATION: the 9th station, where the right paperclip chain joins (~x1440-1530, y1150-1250), renders as a bow- or butterfly-shaped pave cluster with a rectangular, baguette-like stone instead of a haloed heart. The count is still nine, but one station is not a heart. At phone size it is only a small sparkle; at 100% it is plainly wrong.
